{{Quote|Who are you?''"<br />"''Who am I? On Xagobah, we like to ask questions before we answer them.|Boba Fett meets Xeran|<ref name="ANT" />}}
'''Xamsters''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] who hailed from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]]. Xamsters were characterized by their large [[Ear/Legends|ears]], [[Color/Legends|red]] or green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and bicuspid beaks. Their scaly skin ranged in color from yellow to purple and sported several spiky crests. The reptiles stood slightly over one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall on two short [[Limb/Legends|legs]] with splay-toed feet. They had formidable claws and [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]]. Their [[Brain/Legends|brains]] were capable of quickly and efficiently processing sensory input.

The Xamsters cohabited with the myriad [[Fungus/Legends|fungal]] lifeforms on Xagobah, caring for the [[malvil-tree]]s and enjoying food, shelter, and useful [[spore]]s in return. Much of Xamster technology centered on the harvesting and implementation of spores. Members of the species tended to be polite and peaceful with outsiders. Xamsters could be found off-world; the [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Neva Kee/Legends|Neva Kee]] participated in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], for example.

During the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Xamsters found themselves confronting [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces led by [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. The Separatist leader sequestered himself in a citadel called [[Mazariyan]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] Xamsters to defend him from the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When Republic forces did arrive, they, too, drafted Xamster [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], and the species' population centers thinned to the point that not enough Xamsters remained to tend to the malvil-trees. A young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] arrived during the [[Battle of Xagobah (Clone Wars)|Battle of Xagobah]] and befriended a member of the species named [[Xeran]]. With the help of this Xagobah native's knowledge of spore-based technology, Fett infiltrated Mazariyan and allowed the Republic to rout Tambor and his forces.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|The tyrant who is holed up there has twisted the evolution of Xagobah's lifeforms. He has taken fungus that were benign, feeding only on bacteria. He has taken our gentle malvil-trees. He has bio-engineered them so that they are now perverted and kill things without feeding on them.''"<br />"''Things like humanoids.''"<br />"''That is correct. And Xamsters.|Xeran and Boba Fett|<ref name="ANT" />}}
Xamsters were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], bipedal [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] who walked on squat, bowed [[Limb/Legends|legs]] ending in flat feet with four splayed toes and dark, raised nails.<ref name="SWC" /> Their arms, in contrast, were long, thin and muscular,<ref name="ANT" /> and terminated in clawed, four-fingered hands.<ref name="SWC" /><ref name="ANT" /> Members of the species ranged in height from as small as 1.07 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="NK DB" /> to taller than a twelve-year-old [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="ANT" /> Each Xamster had a bulbous abdomen, which narrowed to a sunken chest and a long, thin neck. The reptiles were covered in loose folds of scaly skin<ref name="SWC" /><ref name="ANT" /> that ranged in pigmentation from [[Color/Legends|purple]]<ref name="CSWE III 340" /> to green and yellow. This coloration could vary in a single individual: for instance, the Xamster [[Neva Kee/Legends|Neva Kee]] featured one hue on the back of his torso and head, and the outside of his arms and legs; while scales of another color covered his belly, neck, and throat, and the insides of his arms, legs, and [[Ear/Legends|ears]]. Three crests of spiky growths punctuated the Xamster hide: one ran from the midpoint of the spine to the posterior, another ran down the length of the belly, and a third went from the dome of the head down the back of the skull.<ref name="SWC" />

The head itself was dominated by two [[Bat/Legends|bat]]-like ears<ref name="CSWE III 340" /> that stood erect at both sides of the elongated, high-domed skull. The ears could be parti-colored, with insides and outsides of different hues. The cranium angled from a point in the back downward to the visage. The face tapered to a beak with two sharp, downward-curving points.<ref name="SWC" /> Although this beak lacked lips,<ref name="ANT" /> Xamsters were able to smile,<ref name="EIR">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref> a gesture that revealed their mouthful of white, razor-sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="ANT" /> Two small nostrils on the beak facilitated respiration,<ref name="SWC" /> and two large, ellipsoidal [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with pointed ends<ref name="ANT" /> peered from beneath bony eye sockets.<ref name="SWC" /> These lidless orbs could be jade green<ref name="ANT" /> or red.<ref name="SWC" /> The Xamster [[Brain/Legends|brain]] was specialized to process sensory information quickly.<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|My name is Xeran. I am a Xamster. My family has been bound to this malvil-tree, Malubi, for one thousand turns of Xagobah. Once hundreds of us lived here and harvested Malubi's spores. Now only I remain.|Xeran|<ref name="ANT" />}}
[[File:NevaKee-AnakinsSpeedway.jpg|thumb|left|upright|Xamsters sometimes wore clothing, such as robes.]]
Xamsters lived in communities deep within the [[Fungus/Legends|fungal]] forests of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. They coexisted symbiotically with the fungi: a family of Xamsters bound themselves to a particular type of fungus known as a [[malvil-tree]] and treated it like a beloved pet or even a member of the family. The reptiles gave their own malvil-tree a name and tended to its growth and feeding. In return, the [[Tree/Legends|tree]] permitted the Xamsters to take up residence inside it and obeyed simple commands, like raising or lowering its branches to afford the caretaker a better look at the surrounding terrain. Most importantly, the family was able to harvest the tree's [[spore]]s. They could use these fungal products for diverse tasks. For example, certain spores could be used to coat someone's eyes, granting the ability to peer through the fog of spores that shrouded the surface of Xagobah. Malvil-tree spores also granted safe passage through the forest to those who coated themselves in it; otherwise, other hungry trees might mistake the traveler for a meal. Xamsters knew of other useful fungi as well, including [[Xabar]], which could be used to make a potent form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] with the power to paralyze the user.<ref name="ANT" /> Although offworlders used Xabar to simulate [[Death/Legends|death]] and, they hoped, gain a glimpse of the afterlife,<ref name="AGoSaV">{{InsiderCite|89|Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum and Villainy}}</ref> Xamsters used its coma-inducing properties to fake death and thus escape enemies.<ref name="ANT" />

By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Xamsters had adopted the same technology used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to supplement their fungal tools. For example, members of the species fought with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] during hostilities on their world.<ref name="ANT" /> Although some Xamsters went nude,<ref name="SWC" /> others wore pouches to carry possessions,<ref name="ANT" /> and others wore simple clothing, such as robes.<ref name="AS">''[[Star Wars: Anakin's Speedway]]''</ref> Those engaged in fighting on Xagobah wore purple-gray camouflage to blend in better with their [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] terrain.<ref name="ANT" />

Xamsters were naturally kind and non-violent.<ref name="P">''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]''</ref> They spoke a [[Xamster language|language]] of sharp clicks and guttural growls. Their laughter especially sounded like growling, although a smile conveyed that the deep rumbling noise indicated amusement and humor rather than anger. The species reckoned [[Time/Legends|time]] based on what they called the "turns of Xagobah."<ref name="ANT" /> Some Xamsters went by two-part names, such as Neva Kee,<ref name="NK DB" /> while others introduced themselves by one name alone, such as Xeran.<ref name="ANT" />

==History==
{{Quote|My sympathy lies with the Xamsters.''"<br />"''Very well. I will not detain you. The natives of Xagobah are in dire need of whatever help they are given.|Boba Fett encounters Glynn-Beti after infiltrating Mazariyan|<ref name="ANT" />}}
[[File:Xagobah.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Xamsters evolved on Xagobah in the Outer Rim Territories.]]
Xamsters evolved on Xagobah,<ref name="CSWE III 340" /> a world that circled a blue [[Star/Legends|sun]]<ref name="CD">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> and that was covered in such a prevalence of fungal lifeforms that violet spores permeated the fetid [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] and covered the surface in a thick, purple haze.<ref name="ANT">''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]''</ref> While offworlders who visited the planet had to keep out of the world's harsh sun to avoid being burned,<ref name="CD " /> and wear [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] or take antidotes to counteract harmful spores, lest they be poisoned, Xamsters evolved to tolerate such conditions and to live closely with their planet's most dominant form of life. The reptilian species learned to harness these native fungi, cultivating certain species to harvest specific spores that could perform helpful tasks. In particular, the fungus known as the malvil-tree became an integral part of Xamster culture as families learned to domesticate them for shelter and spore cultivation.<ref name="ANT" />

Representatives of the galaxy beyond Xagobah first reached Xagobah's region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] sometime between [[3000 BBY|3000]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The world lay on an offshoot of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] that ran from the [[Colu system|Colu]] to [[Sharlissia system/Legends|Sharlissia]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Offworlders became more common on the world, some drawn to learn a martial art called [[Tal-Gun]],<ref name="CD" /> and others by the Mayagil sector's amenability to [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="ANT" /> Off-world interests also brought war to the region, and from [[1004 BBY|1,004]] to 1000 BBY, Xagobah fell within the confines of the [[New Sith|Sith Empire]] during the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|War has come to Xagobah. Though we wanted no part of it, still war claimed us. Many of my people have been forced to serve one side or the other. Many others fled, only to be shot in flight. Our malvil-trees are dying of neglect and loneliness. And now I am caught between two armies&mdash;|Xeran|<ref name="ANT" />}}
At some point between [[52 BBY/Legends|52]] and [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Xagobah became a pawn of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] as he manipulated the politics of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] behind the scenes, setting the stage for his alter-ego, Palpatine, to become the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]] of the entire galaxy. When the conflict known as the Clone Wars erupted&mdash;thanks to Sidious' machinations&mdash;the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] consolidated its forces in the Rim<ref name="TEA" /> and sent [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to capture Xagobah.<ref name="CSWE III 340" />

[[File:BobaFett_5_art.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Boba Fett, General Grievous, and Wat Tambor all had a profound effect on the Xamsters of Xagobah during the Clone Wars.]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Xagobah gained a new resident: [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], head of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and a high-ranking leader in the Confederacy.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Tambor molded the native fungi to his will, bioengineering them to form a huge, pyramidal fortress known as the [[Mazariyan]] Citadel, a supposedly impregnable redoubt in which he sequestered himself.<ref name="ANT" /> Meanwhile, Tambor and his forces rounded up Xamsters from the forests of Xagobah to press them into his service; those who refused were summarily executed.<ref name="P" /> By 19.5 BBY, Tambor had embedded himself in a swarm of [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|droid tanks]], [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|spider droids]], and top-of-the-line [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="ANT" />

The Galactic Republic sent [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Glynn-Beti]] to take Tambor into custody. They besieged Mazariyan<ref name="ANT" /> while Republic [[Starship/Legends|starships]] [[Battle of Xagobah (Clone Wars)|battled]] the Confederacy in space around the planet.<ref name="Unknown Soldier">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref> When the Republic [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] realized that they could not sustain their siege with the manpower they had available, they also took to rounding up Xamsters to force them to fight for their side. Such conscripted [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were paid for their service, but they were not given the chance to turn down their summons to military duty. The ongoing hostilities thus forced scores of Xamsters to take up arms, most of whom had never before handled a weapon.<ref name="ANT" /> Xamsters died in great numbers,<ref name="CSWE III 340" /> and their sylvan communities thinned out to such an extent that family malvil-trees went untended and began to die off.<ref name="ANT" />

A Xamster named [[Xeran]] lost most of his family to the fighting, leaving him the sole custodian of the family malvil-tree, [[Malubi]].<ref name="ANT" /><ref name="CSWE III 341">{{CSWECite|III|341|Xeran}}</ref> In 19.42 BBY,<ref name="NEC" /> Xeran came across a young Human [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] trapped inside a carnivorous fungus called a [[flimmel tree]]. The boy blasted his way out, leading Xeran to suspect him of being yet another violent offworlder&mdash;little did the reptile know that the Human was actually a twelve-year-old [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] by the name of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who had been sent to Xagobah by his boss, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], to capture Wat Tambor for the Republic. Xeran led the boy to his family malvil-tree and eventually came to trust the stranger's story that he was an enemy of Wat Tambor's. In the end, the Xamster decided to help the young [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter in his quest. He provided the Human with different types of spores that could aid him in penetrating Mazariyan and apprehending the Separatist leader inside.<ref name="ANT" />

During the encounter, the young Fett felt sympathy for the plight of Xeran and his people. This only fueled his determination to take Tambor's head back to Jabba. The Xamster's gifts proved instrumental in gaining entry to the fortress, but once inside, Fett found Grievous, who proved more than a match for the young Human. The boy used Xeran's Xabar fungus to fake his own death and avoid being killed by the Separatist leaders.<ref name="ANT" /> Although Fett failed to capture Tambor, he allowed the Republic forces to also breach the hideout, sending Tambor and Grievous to flight. Their departure obviated the presence of the Republic ground forces, who also left, and the Xamsters of Xagobah were once again left in peace, albeit as a Republic-held world.<ref name="P" />

===Later history===
After Palpatine's maneuverings secured him the throne of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] launched the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When the Empire was defeated at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the government splintered into squabbling factions. Xagobah fell within the domain of one of them, the [[Eriadu Authority]]. By [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], however, the world and its general region of space had become part of the holdings of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the successor to the Alliance; it remained within New Republic territory until at least [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. The population of the world was somewhere between 10 and 100 million c. [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. Over a century later, in [[137 ABY]], the Xamster homeworld had fallen into territory controlled by [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]], but it fell within the sphere of influence of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], the government that Krayt had toppled.<ref name="TEA" />

==Xamsters in the galaxy==
One Xamster who became well-known off Xagobah was Neva Kee, who made a name for himself on the professional [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] circuit. Kee's unorthodox racing tactics earned him a reputation as a maverick. This status was exemplified by his unusual [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]], a [[Farwan & Glott/Legends|Farwan & Glott]] [[FG 8T8-Twin Block2 Special]], which, unlike most other vehicles in the races Kee entered, had its [[Engine/Legends|engine]] and body joined as a single unit. Kee's rebellious nature earned him many enemies in the sport, but it also garnered the adulation of a large base of fans, who treated Kee as a superstar. Nevertheless, the Xamster kept his cool and single-mindedly pursued his goal to dominate his sport.<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> In 32 BBY, Kee was the favored racer on the [[Baroo Coast/Legends|Baroo Coast]] track on the planet [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]].<ref name="EIR" /> The Xamster's ambitions were brought to an end during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] Podrace on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that same year: the pilot strayed from the course in the second lap, never to be seen again.<ref name="NEGC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Xamster_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Xamster design for ''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' was much more detailed than the digital character eventually inserted into the film.]]
The art department of [[Industrial Light & Magic]] created the Xamster Neva Kee for the Podracing sequence of the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], released in [[1999]]. During the preproduction process, as early as [[1996]], concept sketches by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] were considered interchangeably for both Kee and [[Wan Sandage/Legends|Wan Sandage]], another Podracer pilot.<ref name="EIIG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> After [[George Lucas]] chose the final versions of these two characters, the production team sculpted a detailed character maquette of Kee.<ref name="NK DB" />

Although the podracer pilots were intended to be clothed in ''The Phantom Menace'',<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> and concept drawings of Kee in podracing gear were generated,<ref name="EIIG" /> photographs of the nude maquette have since appeared in numerous sources as Kee himself, rather than as production art.<ref name="EI VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> In the final film, Kee appears only as a low-resolution computer-generated character seated in his racing vehicle.<ref name="NK DB" />
